notes.title: Game-breaking mega 6-month update #2
notes.content: [list][*][p]This update adds MAJOR improvements to petting the dogs that can be found outside of the castle.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]This update also adds MAJOR subtitle fixes (I forgot to type a single word)[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]This update also also adds MAJOR new mechanics. You can now blow out the candle manually by pressing 'F' while holding right-click.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]And also a minor addition I guess is monitor-based framerate limiting. I didn't realize this was an issue so hopefully the game will stop eating up your GPU lol[/p]

tags.feature: This update adds MAJOR improvements to petting the dogs that can be found outside of the castle.

tags.bug: This update also adds MAJOR subtitle fixes (I forgot to type a single word)

tags.feature: This update also also adds MAJOR new mechanics. You can now blow out the candle manually by pressing 'F' while holding right-click.
And also a minor addition I guess is monitor-based framerate limiting. I didn't realize this was an issue so hopefully the game will stop eating up your GPU lol
